title: Sleepy duckling
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sleepy duckling, body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='30' ry='22' fill='#FFD447'/>
  <!-- wing -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='70' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#F2B705'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M78 62 Q90 56 84 70 Q80 66 76 70 Z' fill='#F2B705'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='40' r='20' fill='#FFD447'/>
  <!-- sleepy closed eyes -->
  <path d='M30 38 Q34 43 38 38' stroke='#7A4E00' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M44 38 Q48 43 52 38' stroke='#7A4E00' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='29' cy='46' r='3.5' fill='#FF8C69'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='46' r='3.5' fill='#FF8C69'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M34 48 Q40 54 46 48 Q44 44 40 44 Q36 44 34 48 Z' fill='#FF8A1E'/>
  <path d='M36 48 Q40 51 44 48' stroke='#D96600' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- sleepy cap / little tuft -->
  <path d='M30 24 Q36 14 46 22 Q40 18 34 26 Z' fill='#F2B705'/>
  <!-- tiny zzz -->
  <path d='M66 24 h6 l-6 6 h6' stroke='#A8D8FF' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M76 14 h4 l-4 4 h4' stroke='#A8D8FF' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
